Emily Cramer is a voice actor for the English-language dub of . She is currently affiliated with KMR Talent Agency.

==Biography==
Cramer is an actress who joined the during . Several of her roles were previously done by Kate Bristol, who left the series at the same time as Cramer's arrival.
